```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Full Study 2 sample (before exclusions)

```{r}
dem_solo_full <- demographics %>%
  filter(setup == "SOLO")

dem_solo_full %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    n_unique_ids = n_distinct(id),
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_female = sum(gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_male = sum(gender == "Male", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

dem_solo_full %>%
  count(id, name = "n_people_in_id") %>%
  count(n_people_in_id)
```

## Analytic Study 2 sample (after exclusions)

```{r}
dem_solo_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(
    setup == "SOLO",
    !excluded,
    participant.code != "l6gxo7po",
    participant.code != "n0ndmyka"
  ) # Two participants excluded due to technical errors

solo_ids <- dem_solo_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)


solo_rounds <- roundwise_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "SOLO") %>%
  semi_join(solo_ids, by = "id")
```

```{r}
dem_solo_analytic %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    n_dyads = n_distinct(id),
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_female = sum(gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_male = sum(gender == "Male", na.rm = TRUE),
    language_danish = sum(language == "Danish", na.rm = TRUE),
    language_other = sum(language == "Other", na.rm = TRUE),
    is_parent = sum(parent == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    have_experience = sum(experience == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    regular_exposure = sum(regular == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE))

dem_solo_analytic %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    n_unique_ids = n_distinct(id),
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    language_danish = sum(language == "Danish", na.rm = TRUE),
    language_other = sum(language == "Other", na.rm = TRUE),
    is_parent = sum(parent == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    have_experience = sum(experience == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    regular_exposure = sum(regular == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```

## Derive performance and sound variables

```{r}
solo_rounds <- solo_rounds %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    completed = as.integer(completed),
    success = as.integer(success),
    skipped = as.integer(completed == 0),
    secs = as.numeric(secs),
    log_secs = log(secs + 1),
    secs_sound = replace_na(secs_sound, 0),
    sound_prop = replace_na(sound_prop, 0),
    n_sound_episodes = replace_na(n_sound_episodes, 0),
    any_sound = as.integer(replace_na(any_stimulus, FALSE))) %>%
  mutate(
    sound1_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound1_stimulus, "")),
    sound2_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound2_stimulus, "")),
    sound3_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound3_stimulus, "")),
    any_cry = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "cry|cries")),
    any_alarm = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "alarm")),
    round_sound_type = case_when(
      any_sound == 0 ~ "none",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 0 ~ "cry_only",
      any_cry == 0 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "alarm_only",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "mixed_cry_alarm"),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c("none", "alarm_only", "cry_only", "mixed_cry_alarm")))

solo_rounds %>%
  count(round_sound_type, sort = TRUE)

solo_rounds <- solo_rounds %>%
  filter(round_sound_type != "mixed_cry_alarm")
```

## Sample check

```{r}
solo_rounds %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant.code),
    n_ids = n_distinct(id))

solo_rounds %>%
  group_by(participant.code) %>%
  summarise(n_rounds = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  count(n_rounds)
```

## Sound exposure descriptives

```{r}
solo_rounds %>%
  count(any_sound, sort = TRUE)

solo_rounds %>%
  count(round_sound_type, sort = TRUE)

solo_rounds %>%
  filter(round_sound_type %in% c("cry_only", "alarm_only")) %>%
  count(round_sound_type, gender, sort = TRUE)

solo_rounds %>%
  count(n_sound_episodes)

solo_rounds %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds = n(),
    n_rounds_with_any_sound = sum(any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_rounds_with_any_sound = mean(any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = sum(n_sound_episodes > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = mean(n_sound_episodes > 1, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Round-level descriptive checks

```{r}
solo_rounds %>%
  summarise(
    mean_completed = mean(completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_skipped = mean(skipped, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_success = mean(success, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_secs = mean(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_secs_sound = mean(secs_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sound_prop = mean(sound_prop, na.rm = TRUE))

solo_rounds %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds = n(),
    mean_completed = mean(completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_skipped = mean(skipped, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_success = mean(success, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_secs = mean(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_secs_sound = mean(secs_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sound_prop = mean(sound_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
```

## Participant-level performance descriptives

```{r}
participant_performance <- solo_rounds %>%
  group_by(id, participant.code, gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_matrices_seen = n(),
    n_matrices_completed = sum(completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_matrices_correct = sum(success, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_matrices_skip = sum(skipped, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_round_duration_secs = mean(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rounds_with_any_sound = sum(any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = sum(n_sound_episodes > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

participant_performance %>%
  summarise(
    mean_matrices_seen = mean(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_seen = sd(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_matrices_completed = mean(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_completed = sd(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_matrices_correct = mean(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_correct = sd(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_matrices_skip = mean(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_skip = sd(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_round_duration_s = mean(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_round_duration_secs = sd(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rounds_with_any_sound = mean(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_any_sound = sd(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = mean(n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = sd(n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound, na.rm = TRUE))

participant_performance %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_matrices_seen = mean(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_seen = sd(n_matrices_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_matrices_completed = mean(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_completed = sd(n_matrices_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_matrices_correct = mean(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_correct = sd(n_matrices_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_matrices_skip = mean(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_skip = sd(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_round_duration_s = mean(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_round_duration_secs = sd(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rounds_with_any_sound = mean(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_any_sound = sd(n_rounds_with_any_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = mean(n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound = sd(n_rounds_with_more_than_one_sound, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
```

## Cry, alarm, and no-sound descriptives

```{r}
solo_sound_condition_rounds <- solo_rounds %>%
  filter(round_sound_type %in% c("none", "cry_only", "alarm_only"))

study2_soundtype_participant_performance <- solo_sound_condition_rounds %>%
  group_by(round_sound_type, id, participant.code, gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds_seen = n(),
    n_rounds_completed = sum(completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rounds_correct = sum(success, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_matrices_skip = sum(skipped, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_round_duration_secs = mean(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

study2_soundtype_participant_performance %>%
  group_by(round_sound_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rounds_seen = mean(n_rounds_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_seen = sd(n_rounds_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rounds_completed = mean(n_rounds_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_completed = sd(n_rounds_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rounds_correct = mean(n_rounds_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_correct = sd(n_rounds_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_matrices_skip = mean(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_skip = sd(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_round_duration_s = mean(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_round_duration_secs = sd(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

study2_soundtype_participant_performance %>%
  group_by(round_sound_type, gender) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rounds_seen = mean(n_rounds_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_seen = sd(n_rounds_seen, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rounds_completed = mean(n_rounds_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_completed = sd(n_rounds_completed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rounds_correct = mean(n_rounds_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rounds_correct = sd(n_rounds_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_matrices_skip = mean(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_matrices_skip = sd(n_matrices_skip, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_round_duration_s = mean(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_round_duration_secs = sd(mean_round_duration_secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
```
